messages:
deploy-bot: Starting region-by-region rollout for release v2.3.1 -> pinning model: redwood/opt-7b-q4. Initial slices: US 5%, EU 2%, APAC 0%. Canary in us-east-1. Release window 03:00-06:00 UTC. Rollback trigger: error-rate > 1.5% or latency p95 > 650ms for 5m.
Maria K: copying the checklist here — capacity, warm pools, and throttles all green?
Jon: warm pool ok in us-east, prewarmed GPUs = 12 (target 10). KV cache primed.
Sara P: eu-west warmers at 4, we asked for 6 — we should keep EU at 0% for first pass unless we can hit 6 quickly.
Tim O: APAC still behind on quota approvals, leaving 0% makes sense.
Maria K: cool. pin v2.3.1 at traffic manager: `trafficctl pin --model redwood/opt-7b-q4 --version v2.3.1`
Jon: can someone run a quick smoke script against the canary slice? `scripts/smoke_canary.sh us-east-1`
Sara P: running smoke now, will post results.
ops-bot: smoke job started (id: sj-8821). ETA ~45s.
ops-bot: smoke job finished: 20 requests, 0 errors, avg latency 320ms, p95 465ms.
Maria K: nice. Proceeding to open canary at 5% US. deploy-bot start traffic shift +5% us-east-1 -> v2.3.1
deploy-bot: Traffic shift event: +5% to redwood/opt-7b-q4@v2.3.1 in us-east-1. Observing metrics for 8m.
Jon: watching SLO dashboards — token_throughput and p95_latency panels. Set alert if error_rate > 0.8% for now (tight watch).
Sara P: quick note — if we see model OOMs, fallback plan is to drop to quantized variant `opt-7b-q4-lite`. Toggle via `trafficctl fallback --to opt-7b-q4-lite`
Maria K: agreed. Also hooks: if cost per token spikes >20% vs baseline, do not auto-promote further.
Tim O: APAC ops: will try to get warmers to 6 in the next 90m, but won't block rollout.
ops-bot: Metrics update (8m): error_rate 0.2%, p95 480ms, tokens/sec steady. No OOMs.
Jon: looks good. Hold for 15m observation window, then consider +10% to US if stable.
Maria K: FYI release-notes draft uploaded to /releases/v2.3.1/notes.md (internal). Highlights: perf optimizations, KV cache improvements, minor behavior fix for structured outputs.
Sara P: adding a canary prompt set to the eval harness to check quality drift — kicked off.
deploy-bot: Canary holdpoint reached (15m). No rollback signals. Next recommended step: US +10% at 2750012600 if acked.
Jon: ack from me :thumbsup:
Maria K: ack and monitoring. If any of us see p95 jump >600ms or errors >1.0% for 3m straight, we trigger rollback.
Tim O: will keep APAC updated.
Sara P: Eval harness results incoming — small delta in BLEU-like metric for the structured prompts, within expected range.
ops-bot: scheduled warmup job for eu-west to raise warmers to 6 in 40m (job id jw-771).
Maria K: One more operational item — set deploybot rollback window docs link: https://internal.redwood/release-playbooks/rollback-v2.3.1
Jon: Also adding a short-term throttling rule: route 10% of heavy requests to fallback tier for 30m if p95 > 600ms.
deploy-bot: Noted. Waiting for human thumbs to continue with US +10% step.
Sara P: +1 from me.
Tim O: +1 from ops.
Maria K: proceeding at 2750012600 to US +10% then hold for 20m. tagging oncall for visibility @Jon and @Tim.
ops-bot: roll event scheduled at 2750012600 by Maria K. Monitoring window 20m.
deploy-bot: When rolling, any node-level thermal or OOM events should auto-degrade traffic off the node and surface alerts to #eng-oncall.
Jon: standing by oncall, will escalate if we see degradation.
Sara P: all set. Good run so far, keep an eye on EU warmers.
Maria K: thanks team. If stable after the US ramp we can plan EU gated rollout tomorrow during EU morning window. :rocket:
Jon: copy. Preparing notes for post-mortem if needed.
Tim O: logging ops handoff notes and quota updates.
Ops-bot: Final status (end of thread): US canary -> stable at +15% with no rollback. EU warmers ongoing. APAC pending quota.
